sources.title: Owner-supplied memorial and school enhancement references
sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02. School reference supports edge crowns, small planting patches, open grass and connected courtyard approaches. Exact photograph/source roof alignment remains uncertain; all additions stay within the distinct mapped school boundary. Positions, dimensions and heights are draft estimates; image dates and species unknown. Source-clear fits preserve standing mapped facilities instead of shifting them to the imagery. No reference bitmap ships with the app; no historical dates inferred.
